newsitem.title: USA: CME says open interest on Nasdaq 100 tops 10,000.
newsitem.headline: CME says open interest on Nasdaq 100 tops 10,000.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) said on Friday open interest in Nasdaq 100 stock index futures topped 10,000 for the first time.
The CME said open interest on Nasdaq 100 futures totaled 11,457 at the start of trading on Friday. The futures began trading in early April.
The exchange also said open interest on FLEX options on S&P 500 futures, Russell 2000 stock index futures and S&P 500/BARRA Value stock index futures also reached all-time highs.
